newsitem.title: PERU: Peru sells two fishing units for $11.4 mln.
newsitem.headline: Peru sells two fishing units for $11.4 mln.

text.p: Peru's state fishing company Pescaperu sold two fish oil and fishmeal plants Friday to local firms for $11.4 million, privatization officials said.

Representaciones Servicios Tecnicos EIRL won the bid for Pescaperu's Tambo de Mora Sur SA plant in the southern city of Chincha with a price of $5.802 million, the Commission for the Promotion of Private Investment (COPRI) said in a statement.
APRES SA was the sole bidder for the Ilo Centro SA plant in the southern port Ilo which it bought for $5.555 million, COPRI said.
The base price for the two units was $5.5 million.
Pescaperu is undergoing a piecemeal privatization process and has sold off 16 units so far, generating more than $100 million in revenues.
